_meta.description: 3-stage ProcessChain decorated with one whole-chain OVERLAY_DELTA_VS_STAGE spec (Ref.Stage.Index=0, Target.Stage.Index=2) that emits (stage2_value - stage0_value) per region. Additive sibling of OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_STAGE (11_chain_whole_chain_index_vs_stage.json) — same dual-slot whole-chain barrier wiring, subtractive arithmetic instead of ratio. Each stage preserves SERIES shape (grouper + scalar aggregator on region) so the whole-chain shape gate accepts: stage 0 sums revenue per region (label v), stage 1 sums v per region (label w), stage 2 counts w per region (label c). Output preserves the target stage's units. DELTA does not emit PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO on zero reference value (subtraction is well-defined). Buffered — the whole-chain barrier runs after every stage has produced a Response. Shape-divergence rule (PRD §6 FR-F2) emits PULSE_OVERLAY_CHAIN_STAGE_SHAPE_DIVERGENT when target and reference stage shapes differ. Renderers centre diverging colour ramps on baseline = 0.
_meta.name: chain-delta-vs-stage
